sections.title: Assign prompt ownership after launch
paragraphs:
Lite, Pro and Plus list self-editable prompts. Elite lists initial prompt setup, while the separately quoted Done for You offer lists ongoing prompt work. Initial setup and continuing maintenance are different purchases; ask what each arrangement actually covers.

Use this original ownership card. It should remain usable when the employee who first configured the service is absent.

- Business owner: approves service area, job types, hours and commercial boundaries.
- Instruction editor: makes an authorized change and records which version is active.
- Test reviewer: checks the revised instruction with fictional requests before normal use.
- Handoff owner: maintains the destination and its unavailable-recipient fallback.
- Exception owner: reviews an unresolved answer and decides whether to change the script.
- Provider responsibility: identifies which setup or ongoing tasks are included in the written proposal.

sections.title: Use minutes without inventing a rounding rule
paragraphs:
An original Pro illustration uses 250 billable talk minutes in a month: $99 + (30 × $0.45) = $112.50 before any other applicable charge. Prepare an ordinary period and a busy period from your office’s own observations. Preserve call count, duration and unresolved handoffs separately. More minutes do not establish more qualified inquiries, and a smaller bill does not establish a better customer result.

sections.title: Separate the receptionist from the suite subscription
paragraphs:
Bookipi’s pricing page lists AI Receptionist under add-ons, apart from Free, Starter and Professional. It shows US$199 per month, no yearly plan, and availability in the United States, United Kingdom and Australia. A suite plan’s document allowance does not establish an included receptionist subscription. [Bookipi pricing](https://bookipi.com/pricing/)

Build a short purchase list for the jobs you intend the software to do. Put incoming answering, invoicing, website tools and other proposed products on separate lines. sections.title: Keep the published price discrepancy visible
paragraphs:
The separate receptionist FAQ states US$199.99 per month and 500 incoming calls, while the pricing card states US$199. The two figures were both visible in official sources reviewed October 28, 2026. Preserve that discrepancy and ask Bookipi to confirm the applicable current amount, currency and charges before committing. Do not silently substitute one figure for the other. [Bookipi AI Receptionist FAQ](https://bookipi.com/guides/bookipi-ai-receptionist-faqs/)

A discrepancy log only needs a source link, observation date, conflicting statement and written answer. Keep the answer with the quote so the office can explain the assumption used in its budget. This guide is not a checkout quote and supplies no conclusion about which page takes precedence.

sections.title: Request a call-unit example before budgeting by calls
paragraphs:
The FAQ describes calls from 15 seconds to 4 minutes as one unit and calls below 15 seconds as not counted. Its longer-call wording refers both to additional minutes and to four-minute increments. Those descriptions do not provide a sufficiently clear basis for an independent long-call calculation.

Use this original request: “Please show how a ten-second, two-minute, five-minute and eight-minute incoming call affects our allowance. State the treatment at the exact time boundaries and after the allowance is used. Please distinguish a physical call from the usage units charged.”

Record the returned calculation beside each duration. Do not assume 500 physical calls always mean 500 billable units. A repeat caller also remains a repeat contact, not another customer or job. Keep the usage reconciliation and customer-outcome records separate.

sections.title: Check whether scheduling is enabled or details are recorded
paragraphs:
The FAQ distinguishes enabled scheduling, which adds appointments to Bookipi Scheduler, from disabled scheduling, which records appointment details without scheduling them. Confirm the intended setting and resulting record; a conversation about a possible time is not by itself a confirmed visit.

The official product page describes a dashboard with call information and a path for messages requiring follow-up. Use that as a demonstration target rather than proof that any proposed workflow has been tested. [Bookipi AI Receptionist](https://bookipi.com/ai-receptionist/)

Original fictional case: a homeowner requests a visit but then changes the service location. Ask where the corrected address appears and whether an appointment remains requested or confirmed. Have the office identify the authoritative record and the person who must resolve any mismatch before a crew is committed.

sections.title: Run a small operational decision worksheet
paragraphs:
Complete the following original worksheet with verified answers before changing your business number’s route. Unknown is a useful status; it should not become an assumed feature.

- Purchase: receptionist subscription, selected region, confirmed price and separate suite products required.
- Metering: short-call boundary, long-call examples, allowance reset and treatment after allowance exhaustion.
- Call handling: approved service scope, questions, business hours and instructions for unsupported requests.
- Scheduling: enabled or disabled, appointment types and where the confirmed record is found.
- Office work: who checks messages, corrects business information and acts on unresolved requests.
- Acceptance: written answers, proposed test case and the authorized person deciding whether the workflow is ready.

sections.title: Compare only the Revo function you actually need
paragraphs:
Revo’s current pricing describes AI answering, own-script rules, booking and summaries. Transfers to the customer’s own team are listed on eligible plans. Those descriptions do not establish a Bookipi connection, equivalent suite tools or an identical call-unit model. [Revo plans](/pricing)

sections.title: Start with the purchase you actually need
paragraphs:
ZyraTalk by EverPro presents a platform spanning inbound AI calls, webchat, outbound calling and outbound SMS. Its website also describes connections to field-service and CRM software. Those descriptions make it worth asking about a broader communications workflow, not treating the product as only a telephone greeting.

Do not turn the feature list into an assumption that every function is included in one price. Ask which tasks are available in the proposal, how usage is measured, who configures them and what remains outside scope. A demo request is not a price commitment, and an older third-party starting price is not a substitute for the current offer.

sections.title: Clarify the Invoice Simple route before comparing offers
paragraphs:
Invoice Simple’s official help article documents an AI Receptionist entry under Tools. Its setup collects business details and then directs the user to the ZyraTalk platform to configure the assistant. The article describes answering client calls, appointment-related help and basic business questions.

That establishes a documented entry point, not the complete commercial agreement. If you already use Invoice Simple, ask whether your proposed service is purchased through that route or separately. Confirm account ownership, the billing party, which subscription is required and which support team owns an issue after the handoff. The setup article does not establish a price or prove that every capability on ZyraTalk’s main website is included.

sections.title: Take this scope sheet into the quote conversation
paragraphs:
Use the same sheet for each offer you receive. Mark an item unnecessary when it is outside your first purchase rather than allowing it to disappear inside a broad platform description.

| Quote item | Decision to document |
| --- | --- |
| Inbound phone coverage | Number, answering periods, permitted intake and booking actions |
| Webchat | Whether required, where deployed and who receives exceptions |
| Outbound phone and SMS | Whether requested at all; specific tasks and operating ownership |
| Software connection | Exact product/account, fields, direction and booking authority |
| Usage and charges | Billable unit, allowance if any, excess usage and other applicable charges |
| Account and support | Purchase route, billing party, configuration owner and exit process |

sections.title: Try a fictional buyer case without inventing a price
paragraphs:
Consider a fictional HVAC office that uses Invoice Simple and initially wants evening calls answered, service details captured and appointment requests handled under its rules. The office does not need outbound campaigns or webchat in this first stage.

The buyer asks whether ZyraTalk can quote that defined scope through the documented Invoice Simple route, then requests the corresponding account and support terms. If an offer includes more functions, the office asks which are optional, which are part of the package and how the total would change under the provider’s actual commercial rules.

No dollar total can be responsibly calculated from that case without the quote. Nor does the example establish that modules can be purchased separately. Its purpose is to prevent an inbound requirement from being compared with an unexplained multi-channel package.

sections.title: Require evidence at the booking and exception boundary
paragraphs:
For a demonstration, supply fictional requests and write the expected result first. Ask the provider to show an ordinary inquiry, a requested time that is unavailable and a customer asking to change existing work. Inspect the resulting record and which person owns the next action.

If a software connection is proposed, distinguish a captured time preference from a confirmed appointment in the authoritative schedule. Ask what happens when the destination cannot accept an update. These are suggested checks, not tests we performed, and they do not authorize messages, campaigns or changes to a live customer account.

sections.title: Compare Revo on the same inbound requirement
paragraphs:
Revo’s Pricing page describes AI answering plans with the business’s script and rules, booking and SMS follow-up; transfers to the customer’s team are listed for Crew and Fleet. Use that published scope as a separate comparison line.

Do not infer a Revo connection to Invoice Simple or another named field-service platform, an outsourced human answering network or outbound phone campaigns. If the main requirement is a wider communications ecosystem, evaluate that scope directly with the supplier. If the need is inbound coverage, compare the supported handling, capacity, handoff and written charges for that specific task.

sections.title: Questions

sections.title: Separate the measurement request from the installation commitment
paragraphs:
Before using an answering service, decide whether the next appointment is a site measurement, an office or showroom consultation, or a follow-up discussion about an existing estimate. An opening in one appointment type does not establish availability for another.

Ask the caller which rooms or areas they want to discuss, whether this concerns new installation or replacement, and whether they have selected or purchased material. Record the answers as the caller's description. Dimensions or square footage supplied by the homeowner remain unverified until your business completes its own measurement process.

Do not convert those dimensions into an order quantity, waste allowance, material recommendation or labor price. A reception flow also cannot determine whether the existing surface or subfloor is suitable for installation. Your estimator or installer must review those questions.

sections.title: Use this measurement-request and follow-up register
paragraphs:
Copy this proposed register into your office's approved process. It is a planning resource, not a claim that Revo supplies a flooring estimating system or these exact form fields.

| Record | What reception can capture under your instructions | Office check before committing |
|---|---|---|
| Contact and property | Name, callback number, property location and caller's role | Service area and who may authorize a visit |
| Requested appointment | Measurement, material consultation or estimate follow-up | Correct appointment type and responsible person |
| Areas involved | Rooms or areas as described by the caller | Actual site scope and professional measurements |
| Measurement status | Not measured, caller-provided dimensions or prior professional visit | Identify the source; do not label caller dimensions verified |
| Material status | Undecided, selected or already purchased, as stated | Product suitability, quantities and responsibility for supply |
| Existing work | Estimate reference or current-job reference if supplied | Locate the correct office record before discussing changes |
| Visit context | Occupied home, requested access discussion and preferred period | Authorized access arrangement and practical visit requirements |
| Next owner | Estimator, material adviser or current-project coordinator | Named person accepts follow-up; request versus confirmed appointment recorded |

Ask only for information the office needs. Do not request entry codes, payment-card details or unrelated household information to complete a preliminary request. A project reference alone does not prove that a caller is authorized to change the work.

sections.title: Give an existing estimate a different next step
paragraphs:
A caller who already has a quote should not automatically receive another initial measurement appointment. Capture the reference and the question: are they asking to discuss the material, understand the proposed work, revisit the timing or request a change? The office should locate the applicable estimate and decide whether a new visit is necessary.

Similarly, a current installation customer's question belongs with the project owner. Reception can record the requested change but should not accept extra rooms, approve a substitution, change the contract price or promise a revised completion date. A clear message is useful even when the required answer must come from your team.

sections.title: Evaluate answering coverage with three fictional calls
paragraphs:
Ask for an authorized demonstration before routing customer calls. Use a homeowner who has not chosen material, another who supplies approximate dimensions and a third who already has an estimate. Inspect whether the resulting summaries preserve those distinctions and identify the appropriate office recipient.

Where a supported booking setup confirms an approved measurement slot, verify the appointment type and next step. Otherwise, capture the preference for staff confirmation. Do not tell a caller an installation is scheduled merely because a measurement visit has been requested.

Revo's pricing page lists appointment booking, summaries and your own script, hours and rules. It lists team transfers for Crew and Fleet; Solo excludes them. Confirm the exact calendar, message delivery and unavailable-recipient fallback for your configuration. No native flooring-estimating or order-management connection is established by this page.

Other models are available. SMA Support publishes a flooring-contractor offering that includes phone answering and broader office support. That describes its scope, not proof that Revo performs its back-office, accounting or insurance work. Compare the answering tasks you actually need instead of treating all outsourced services as equivalent. [SMA flooring services](https://www.smasupport.us/back-office-outsourcing-bpo-services-contractors-served/flooring/)

paragraphs: This page concerns installation or replacement intake and the preparation of a measurement request. For renewal of an existing wood finish, see [hardwood-refinishing answering](/ai-answering-service/hardwood-refinishing-answering-service). For a coating applied to an existing surface, see [floor-coating answering](/ai-answering-service/floor-coating-answering-service). Keep those service boundaries in your greeting and approved questions.

sections.title: Questions before choosing coverage
paragraphs:
**Can reception estimate the flooring quantity from room dimensions?** This workflow records caller-supplied information. It does not calculate an order or replace the installer's measurement and material review.

**Can it confirm a measurement appointment?** Only through a supported booking configuration using your approved appointment type and availability. Otherwise the office confirms the request.

**Can an existing customer approve a material change by phone?** Reception can capture the request. Your office must verify authority and accept any change through its approved process.

**Next step:** [Review Revo's plans](https://www.revoapp.ai/pricing) and bring your measurement appointment types, intake questions and office recipients. Ask the team to demonstrate the supported answering and handoff workflow before you buy.
